scope: One public JFK clip on T4. One warmup and three measured independent processes per engine; each process performs two calls after loading. Native Q4_K and original F16 have different precision. Process times include loading and GPU monitoring; second-call operation boundaries differ.

settings.instruction: transcribe the speech with proper punctuation and capitalization.

limitations: Native decode timing excludes graph construction, prefill and the first token; original generate includes prefill and additional stages. Do not infer a cross-engine decode-only speedup.
The F16 and Q4_K models have different numerical precision.
Native reports 26 greedy decoder calls after the prefill token; the original output has 27 generated tokens. These counts have different boundaries.
One clip and one GPU do not establish general recognition or performance acceptance.
